headline: Company Culture Match, from entry to detail
overview: Pick your top 5 career values, then rate companies against them to find your best culture fit. Make more informed job decisions based on what actually matters to you.
targetAudience: Users interested in career tools for personal growth and self-discovery.

keyFeatures: Select your top 5 career values from a curated list (e.g., autonomy, impact, stability, growth)
Rate multiple companies against your chosen values to generate fit scores
Side-by-side comparison of companies weighted by what matters most to you
Helps you move beyond salary and title to evaluate culture alignment objectively
tips: Be ruthless about your top 5 values — forcing yourself to prioritize is the point. If everything is important, nothing is.
Try to rate companies based on what you know (interviews, Glassdoor, conversations with employees) rather than their marketing — culture fit depends on reality, not branding.
